text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the school gate, 
Air Groove and Tokai Teio were there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found another playmate! Air Groove's 
Trainer is joining in too♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't go dragging me into this!
choice_data_list: Were you about to head out to play?
Were you about to go out and play?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She was making such a fuss, complaining 
how bored she was without the President 
around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to kick them out, but 
somehow I got dragged all the way out 
here...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just give it up and play with yours truly! 
All right, let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... Wait, I said stop pulling!! You...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're here! Let's race right away, Air 
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just one race. After that, I'm going 
home.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Air Groove's Trainer gets to pick 
which game we'll compete in!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove doesn't really seem like the 
type to play games, y'know? Think of it as 
a handicap!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A handicap, you say? Hmph... you've got 
some nerve.

The game I'll have the two of you play 
is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! Are you really sure about that? 
That's my absolute best genre, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter the match, I won't flinch. Bring 
it on, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I'm not gonna go easy on you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Whoop! Alright, extra stage cleared with 
a Perfect too!

Tokai Teio's steps were so mesmerizing, I 
couldn't help but be captivated...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how's that, Air Groove! You'll 
neeeever beat my score—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Where's Air Groove? Is she 
still playing?

Hearing that, I realized I had looked away 
and hurriedly searched for her, only to 
find...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Who do you think you are? How insolent...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I just thought you looked 
seriously gorgeous while dancing~!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we'll pay for it, so come on, let us 
see you play one more time! You came here 
to play games anyway, so what's the harm?

My body moved to step in between them. But 
faster still, a small shadow dashed past 
my side. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, heeeeyーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey you guys, what do you think you're 
doing?! Cut that out in my playground!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if you wanted to watch, I 
could've shown you a far more magnificent 
dance..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, let's go. Someone real 
troublesome just showed up.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Next time for the little ones, 
okay~...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's that supposed to mean?! Who 
are you calling a runt?! Geez!! How rude!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... You're not helping either, Air 
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tha~t's riiiight! What was with that 
attitude just now!? You always yell at me 
with a waaay scarier face!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, your eyebrows were slanted up 
waaaay more like thiiiis, weren't they?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's only natural that I'd treat a 
stranger differently from how I treat you, 
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's noooot the point! You don't get it, 
you don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Am I actually being scolded by you 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Me, against Teio? Heh... Hehehe. 
Heheheh...!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What are you laughing at?! Listen 
to me seriously, jeez~~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
N-No, my apologies. But I just can't help 
it... Pfft, hahaha...!!

Faced with such an unusual situation, Air 
Groove couldn't help but burst into 
laughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho... a game where knowledge and strategy 
reign supreme? This should be reasonably 
entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's a game that takes brains, 
even I'm pretty good at it, you know!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...First, it's crucial to understand the 
cards' properties. Alright Teio, wait just 
a moment."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead! In the meantime, I think 
I'll go play the crane game.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to memorize the cards?
Don't you need to memorize the cards?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've played this game a few times before, 
ya know? I've pretty much got it all 
memorized.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's no need to panic now, after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, got it memorized. Sorry to 
keep you waiting, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's only worth about 20 pieces of candy, 
so it's not a big dealâª

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, without further ado... Game 
start!

And so the showdown began, with Tokai Teio 
holding the upper hand right from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun dragging this out forever... 
Time to finish this off with this oneee—!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A wealth of knowledge, paired with 
guts when it counts. An ordinary opponent 
wouldn't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, well~ How rare for you, Air Groove! 
Could it be that you're surrendering~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No? ――I did say "an average opponent," 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do not insult this "Empress" by counting 
me among the ordinary...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, taste the full force of my army's 
counterattack!
(ROAAAAAAR!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: W-Waaaah~!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I... I loooost~~~~!? Me!? But hoooow~?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An opponent with a gap in experience, 
conviction in one's specialty, and the 
confidence born of natural talent...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The 'carelessness' born from a 
combination of all those factors is the 
reason you lost, Teio."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Letting our guard down...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I'll memorize all the cards again! Wait 
right there, it'll only take a sec!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you're the "Empress," then I'm the 
"Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Bursting with confidence, it's a piece of 
cake!" ...I wouldn't be me if I couldn't 
win with that kind of attitude!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well, I'll wait for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Just you watch, next time for 
sure...!
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to seeing how this 
match turns out.

I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of 
match it'll be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...For once, we actually agree on 
something.

And so, Air Groove thoroughly enjoyed her 
match against Tokai Teio.
